Application Data.NAME: Sunny Side Diner
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sunny Side Diner is a fast food and family restaurant specializing in classic American comfort food, including breakfast items, burgers, sandwiches, salads, and a variety of desserts. We prioritize food safety and adhere strictly to health codes, with regular inspections and staff training on food handling practices. Our kitchen is equipped with modern cooking equipment, and we have implemented a comprehensive maintenance schedule to prevent equipment failure and fire hazards. Additionally, we offer delivery services using insured commercial vehicles operated by trained drivers, ensuring safety during transport. Customer satisfaction and a family-friendly atmosphere are at the core of our operations, bolstered by a commitment to quality and community engagement.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On February 15, 2023, a slip and fall incident occurred when a customer slipped on a wet floor near the entrance. The total estimated cost for medical expenses and settlement is $2,500. The claim is currently in the negotiation phase, and we are working closely with our insurance adjuster to finalize the resolution.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: UL 10-3, Class B, Central Station Monitored
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fence surrounding the premises, two on-site security personnel during peak hours, and a monitored alarm system with remote monitoring capabilities.
